column1: # Letter signs of the cardinal of Tortosa's cipher, 1520-1521.
# id: letter plus the position of the sign in the column of that letter in Kolosova's thesis, p. 227
#     (first sign from the top = 1). The shape column is a plain description for finding the sign
# source K = Kolosova's table; S = found in this study (see docs/METHOD.md).
# The u signs serve for u and v, the i signs for i, j and y, the c signs for c and c-cedilla.
# Kolosova heads the u column "b*/u/v". In the letters read here b has signs of its own, which
# are not in Kolosova's table and are not needed for the paragraph (see data/test_passage.tsv).
# The table in the thesis draws f1 and h3 alike. Neither occurs in the passages transcribed here.
